concepts.preferred_label: Chronic Graft-Versus-Host Disease of the Eye
concepts.why: The patient's chronic eye symptoms, subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, corneal neovascularizations, and conjunctival hyperemia are consistent with chronic graft-versus-host disease of the eye.
The patient's subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, corneal neovascularizations, and conjunctival hyperemia are consistent with ocular cicatricial pemphigoid.
The patient's corneal neovascularizations and conjunctival hyperemia are consistent with corneal limbal stem cell deficiency.
The patient's conjunctival hyperemia is consistent with conjunctivitis.
The patient's chronic eye symptoms and vision deterioration are consistent with keratoconjunctivitis sicca.
The patient's corneal neovascularizations and conjunctival hyperemia are consistent with corneal ulcer.
